```{r}
N172010 <- read_csv("Data/N172010.csv")
N172018 <- read_csv("Data/N172018.csv")
clean_year <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Year_raw = as.character(Year),
      # pull the first 4-digit year (e.g., "2024 (provisional)" -> 2024)
      Year = readr::parse_number(Year_raw),
      # keep any extra text as a note (optional)
      Year_note = str_squish(str_remove(Year_raw, "^\\d{4}"))
    )
}

N17 <- bind_rows(
  clean_year(N172010 ),
  clean_year(N172018 )
) %>%
  select(-Year_raw)
```

```{r}

prep_yearly_rate <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Deaths),
      !is.na(Population),
      !is.na(Year),
      !(`Ten-Year Age Groups Code` %in% c("Under 1","1-4","5-14","15-24"))
    ) %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(Deaths),
      pop    = sum(Population),
      rate   = deaths / pop * 1e5,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

N17_rate    <- prep_yearly_rate(N17)
A40_rate    <- prep_yearly_rate(A40)
N17A40_rate <- prep_yearly_rate(N17A40)
```

```{r}
library(segmented)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

calc_joinpoint_apc <- function(df, outcome, max_k = 1) {

  lm0 <- lm(log(rate) ~ Year, data = df)

  seg <- segmented(
    lm0,
    seg.Z = ~Year,
    npsi  = max_k
  )

  slopes <- slope(seg)$Year
  joins  <- seg$psi[, "Est."]

  tibble(
    Outcome = outcome,
    Segment = seq_len(nrow(slopes)),
    Start_Year = c(min(df$Year), round(joins)),
    End_Year   = c(round(joins), max(df$Year)),
    APC = (exp(slopes[,1]) - 1) * 100
  )
}


```
```{r}
joinpoint_apc_tbl <- bind_rows(
  calc_joinpoint_apc(N17_rate,    "Renal failure (N17–N19)"),
  calc_joinpoint_apc(A40_rate,    "Sepsis (A30–A49)"),
  calc_joinpoint_apc(N17A40_rate, "Renal failure + Sepsis")
)

joinpoint_apc_tbl
```

## APC by time period
```{r}
calc_period_apc <- function(df, outcome, start, end, label) {

  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(Year >= start, Year <= end)

  # Guard against single-year periods
  if (n_distinct(df_sub$Year) < 2) {
    return(
      tibble(
        Outcome = outcome,
        Period  = label,
        Start_Year = start,
        End_Year   = end,
        APC   = NA_real_,
        Lower = NA_real_,
        Upper = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  fit <- lm(log(rate) ~ Year, data = df_sub)

  beta <- coef(fit)[2]
  se   <- summary(fit)$coef[2, 2]

  tibble(
    Outcome = outcome,
    Period  = label,
    Start_Year = start,
    End_Year   = end,
    APC   = (exp(beta) - 1) * 100,
    Lower = (exp(beta - 1.96 * se) - 1) * 100,
    Upper = (exp(beta + 1.96 * se) - 1) * 100
  )
}



```

```{r}
apc_period_tbl <- bind_rows(

  # --------------------
  # Renal failure (N17–N19)
  # --------------------
  calc_period_apc(N17_rate, "Renal failure", 2010, 2019, "Pre-pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(N17_rate, "Renal failure", 2020, 2022, "Pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(N17_rate, "Renal failure", 2023, 2025, "Post-pandemic"),

  # --------------------
  # Sepsis (A30–A49)
  # --------------------
  calc_period_apc(A40_rate, "Sepsis ", 2010, 2019, "Pre-pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(A40_rate, "Sepsis", 2020, 2022, "Pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(A40_rate, "Sepsis", 2023, 2025, "Post-pandemic"),

  # --------------------
  # Renal failure + Sepsis
  # --------------------
  calc_period_apc(N17A40_rate, "Renal failure & Sepsis", 2010, 2019, "Pre-pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(N17A40_rate, "Renal failure & Sepsis", 2020, 2022, "Pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(N17A40_rate, "Renal failure & Sepsis", 2023, 2025, "Post-pandemic")
)

apc_period_tbl
```

## Plot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

plot_apc_trend <- function(df, outcome, apc_tbl) {

  apc_val <- apc_tbl %>% filter(Outcome == outcome)

  ggplot(df, aes(Year, rate)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, color = "#00468B") +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      formula = y ~ exp(x),
      se = FALSE,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = outcome,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "APC = ",
        round(apc_val$APC, 2), "% (",
        round(apc_val$Lower, 2), ", ",
        round(apc_val$Upper, 2), ")"
      ),
      y = "Mortality rate per 100,000",
      x = "Year"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
}

```

```{r}
calc_period_apc <- function(df, outcome, start, end, label) {

  df_sub <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Year >= start, Year <= end) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(rate), is.finite(rate), rate > 0)

  # Need >=2 distinct years to estimate a slope
  if (nrow(df_sub) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(df_sub$Year) < 2) {
    return(
      tibble(
        Outcome = outcome,
        Period = label,
        Start_Year = start,
        End_Year = end,
        APC = NA_real_,
        Lower = NA_real_,
        Upper = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  fit <- lm(log(rate) ~ Year, data = df_sub)

  beta <- coef(fit)[2]
  se   <- summary(fit)$coef[2, 2]

  tibble(
    Outcome = outcome,
    Period = label,
    Start_Year = start,
    End_Year = end,
    APC   = (exp(beta) - 1) * 100,
    Lower = (exp(beta - 1.96 * se) - 1) * 100,
    Upper = (exp(beta + 1.96 * se) - 1) * 100
  )
}

```

```{r}
apc_period_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(

  # Renal failure (N17–N19)
  calc_period_apc(N17_rate, "Renal failure", 2010, 2019, "Pre-pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(N17_rate, "Renal failure", 2020, 2022, "Pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(N17_rate, "Renal failure", 2023, 2025, "Post-pandemic"),

  # Sepsis (A30–A49)
  calc_period_apc(A40_rate, "Sepsis", 2010, 2019, "Pre-pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(A40_rate, "Sepsis", 2020, 2022, "Pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(A40_rate, "Sepsis", 2023, 2025, "Post-pandemic"),

  # Renal failure & Sepsis
  calc_period_apc(N17A40_rate, "Renal failure & Sepsis", 2010, 2019, "Pre-pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(N17A40_rate, "Renal failure & Sepsis", 2020, 2022, "Pandemic"),
  calc_period_apc(N17A40_rate, "Renal failure & Sepsis", 2023, 2025, "Post-pandemic")
)
```

```{r}
make_period_fit_lines <- function(rates_all, apc_period_tbl) {

  apc_period_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(Period %in% c("Pre-pandemic", "Pandemic", "Post-pandemic")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(APC)) %>%   # exclude periods not estimable
    rowwise() %>%
    do({
      out   <- .$Outcome
      start <- .$Start_Year
      end   <- .$End_Year
      per   <- .$Period

      df_sub <- rates_all %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          Outcome == out,
          Year >= start, Year <= end,
          !is.na(rate), is.finite(rate), rate > 0
        )

      # Guard: need >=2 years
      if (nrow(df_sub) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(df_sub$Year) < 2) {
        return(tibble(Outcome = character(), Period = character(),
                      Year = integer(), fit_rate = double()))
      }

      fit <- lm(log(rate) ~ Year, data = df_sub)

      yrs <- tibble(Year = seq(min(df_sub$Year), max(df_sub$Year), by = 1))
      pred <- exp(predict(fit, newdata = yrs))

      tibble(
        Outcome = out,
        Period  = per,
        Year    = yrs$Year,
        fit_rate = pred
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

fit_lines <- make_period_fit_lines(rates_all, apc_period_tbl)

```

```{r}
apc_labels <- apc_period_tbl %>%
  dplyr::filter(Period %in% c("Pre-pandemic", "Pandemic", "Post-pandemic")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mid_year = (Start_Year + End_Year) / 2,
    label = sprintf("%s: %.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)", Period, APC, Lower, Upper)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    rates_all %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Outcome) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(y_top = max(rate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "Outcome"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y = y_top * 0.92) %>%   # place labels near top
  dplyr::select(Outcome, mid_year, y, label)

```

```{r}
apc_subtitles <- apc_period_tbl %>%
  filter(Period %in% c("Pre-pandemic", "Pandemic", "Post-pandemic")) %>%
  mutate(
    txt = sprintf(
      "%s: %.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)",
      Period, APC, Lower, Upper
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    subtitle = paste(txt, collapse = "  |  "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- Plot ----
apc_trend_plot_clean <- ggplot(rates_all, aes(Year, rate)) +

  # Pandemic shading
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2020, xmax = 2022.5,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2022.5, xmax = 2025,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey90", alpha = 0.4) +

  # Raw trend
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +

  # APC fitted slopes (lighter, secondary)
  geom_line(
    data = fit_lines,
    aes(y = fit_rate),
    linewidth = 0.9,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey30"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~Outcome, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +

  labs(
    title = "Mortality rate trends with period-specific APC fits",
    subtitle = "Shaded regions indicate pandemic (2020–2022) and post-pandemic (2023–2025) periods",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Rate per 100,000"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# ---- Add APC subtitles to each facet ----
apc_trend_plot_clean +
  geom_text(
    data = apc_subtitles,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = subtitle),
    hjust = -0.02, vjust = 1.2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.2
  )
```
